title: PR governance: route changed files to required risk-evidence checks
spec: PR governance currently checks issue links and hygiene but does not look at WHICH files a PR changes. Add risk routing to the GitHub governance CLI's PR check: map changed file paths to risk areas (desktop/local execution, protocol, security/data/billing, release/deploy, UI needing visual QA) and warn with the specific missing evidence route for each matched area, so a PR touching a risky area cannot silently pass with a generic checklist.
